publications.title: Antitrust Regulatory Gap in IndiGo Airlines 2025 Fiasco : Lessons from the US and EU
publications.tldr: India's aviation market is highly concentrated, with IndiGo's dominance and a December 2025 crisis exposing weaknesses in the country's competition law framework. Comparing India's restrained approach with U.S. and EU enforcement, the paper argues for stronger proactive safeguards to protect consumer welfare in essential infrastructure sectors.

publications.title: Finance Comics: Pricing Black-Scholes Concepts
publications.tldr: A comic-format explainer on derivatives pricing and Black-Scholes theory, designed to make quantitative finance concepts visually intuitive and accessible.

publications.title: The Work You Cannot See: Book-Building of a Billion-Dollar Bond Deal
publications.tldr: Who gets paid for book building of a billion-dollar bond deal. A flip-book walkthrough of the work behind the allocation.

publications.title: Mathematics for Finance: Volatility Modeling
publications.tldr: A self-assessment guide on volatility modeling, written as a flip book rather than a formal paper.
